name: Journalist query answer writer
why: Picks the journalist requests worth answering and writes skimmable expert answers, the same job as the journalist request answer prompt.

name: Store link gap planner
why: Measures an online shop's referring-domain gap against rivals and drafts pitches for earned links only, with no paid links.

name: Guide outreach list planner
why: Checks a guide is worth sharing, then plans who to contact and a small first send, matching the prospect scoring and pitch skills.

name: Press outreach experiment planner
why: Runs press outreach as a small pilot with a reporter list, one pitch and stop rules, a good first test before a full campaign.

name: AI citation source finder
why: Finds the sites AI tools keep citing for buyer questions, which often make strong prospects for earned links and mentions.

name: SEO and AI search agency vetter
why: Spots red flags in an agency proposal, such as bought links or guaranteed rankings, before the client signs.

name: Monthly Search Console keeper
why: A monthly Search Console review that shows which linked pages are gaining or losing ground.

name: Monthly content decay keeper
why: Finds pages losing traffic each month, so link-worthy assets can be refreshed before their links go stale.

name: Store advertorial writer
why: Writes a paid advertorial that is labelled as an ad, for clients who choose paid exposure the honest way.
